immune_tcell_effector.description: CD8 T-cell / T-cell-inflamed effector signature (immune infiltration).
immune_tcell_effector.reference: CD8 T-effector / T-cell-inflamed signature as used in IMvigor210/POPLAR IO studies (Rosenberg et al., Lancet 2016; Ayers et al., J Clin Invest 2017 T-cell-inflamed GEP).

cytotoxic.description: Cytotoxic effector program (granzymes, perforin, NK/CTL effectors).
cytotoxic.reference: Extended cytotoxic panel; core CYT (GZMA, PRF1) from Rooney et al., Cell 2015.

exhaustion.reference: Canonical inhibitory checkpoint / exhaustion markers (Wherry & Kurachi, Nat Rev Immunol 2015; Thommen & Schumacher, Cancer Cell 2018).

cytotoxic_rooney_CYT.description: Rooney cytolytic activity = geometric mean of GZMA and PRF1 (computed from raw RSEM where available).

scoring: Signature score = mean of per-gene, per-cohort z-scores (mRNA z-scores relative to all samples, log RSEM). Spearman correlation is invariant to any monotonic per-gene transform, so ranks are identical to raw RSEM.
